label: Coronary Artery Disease
blurb: Atherosclerotic narrowing and occlusion of the coronary arteries — from silent plaque to acute infarction.

label: Heart Failure
blurb: The clinical syndrome that results when the heart cannot meet the body's demands at normal filling pressures.

label: Arrhythmias
blurb: Disorders of impulse formation and conduction, from benign ectopy to life-threatening ventricular rhythms.

label: Valvular Heart Disease
blurb: Stenosis and regurgitation of the four cardiac valves, and the ventricular remodelling that follows.

label: Cardiomyopathies
blurb: Primary diseases of the myocardium itself — dilated, hypertrophic, restrictive and arrhythmogenic.

label: Congenital Heart Disease
blurb: Structural abnormalities present from birth, and the lifelong physiology they create.

label: Hypertension
blurb: The commonest modifiable cardiovascular risk factor and a driver of nearly every other cardiac disease.

label: Vascular Disease
blurb: Arterial and venous disease beyond the heart — limb ischaemia, venous insufficiency and their consequences.

label: Pericardial Disease
blurb: Inflammation, effusion and constriction of the sac surrounding the heart.

label: Endocardial Disease
blurb: Infection and inflammation of the endocardium and valves, including endocarditis and rheumatic disease.

label: Aortic Disease
blurb: Aneurysm, dissection and acute aortic syndromes affecting the body's largest artery.

label: Thromboembolic Disease
blurb: Venous thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and the pulmonary vascular consequences of obstruction.
